chunks: Then, frequently monitor his judicial decisions,
and allow him ample provision (wealth) that removes his excuse (for dishonesty), and his need for people becomes small.
and give him from the rank/status with you that which no one else among your elites aspires to,
so that he may be safe from the assassination/killing by men (rivals) against him in your presence.
So look into that with a piercing gaze, for indeed this religion had been a prisoner in the hands of the wicked, acted upon according to desire, and worldly wealth was sought through it.
ai.seo_question: What are the key administrative and ethical instructions for a governor in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage from Imam Ali’s letter to Malik al-Ashtar highlights the critical link between judicial integrity and administrative patronage, urging the governor to ensure judges are financially independent to prevent corruption and social dependency. It contextualizes the judiciary not merely as a legal function but as a sacred trust that was historically compromised by worldly ambitions, a warning rooted in the Shia emphasis on *Adl* (justice) as a divine attribute manifested through righteous leadership.
